items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: When I first went in that band... They had Frankie Doocy

ctx.x: Was that mostly a big brass band? Big brass band.
When I first went in that band, Mr. Bill, once they had about twenty or more trombone players. They had Frankie Doocy, you remember him?
I didn't know him but I heard all about him.
